scope: PUBLIC METADATA / PUBLICATION ONLY. No molecular patient-level matrices downloaded or harmonized in this audit.

datasets.name: Ng et al Nat Commun 2022 multi-etiology HCC
datasets.access: RNA-seq raw restricted EGA EGAS00001005074; proteome public PRIDE PXD025705; phosphoproteome public PRIDE PXD025836; processed source data exists but matching not audited
datasets.next_action: Check article Source Data and supplementary patient/sample IDs against PRIDE protein matrices; request EGA RNA access if needed. Do not treat paper counts as downloadable pairs.

observed_public_metadata.key_limitation: Published metadata flags/ID join only. Raw RNA EGA-controlled. Actual RNA/proteome expression matrices not both obtained or harmonized; prognosis is OS-focused and recurrence not validated.

public_file_inventory.warning: Workbook sheet geometries and PRIDE filenames only; no verified patient-by-gene quant matrix or RNA/protein paired expression join.

datasets.name: Gao et al Cell 2019 HBV-HCC
datasets.access: Published integrated paired tumor/non-tumor cohort; RNA BioSino OEP000321 and proteome CPTAC/ICPC reported; file-level join not inspected
datasets.next_action: Download processed matrices and metadata separately, check common patient and specimen identifiers; HBV-only reference is not a nonviral validation cohort.

observed_public_metadata.key_limitation: PDC case count 171 is repository metadata and NOT necessarily the 159 tumor patients reported in Gao Cell paper. Distinct tumor cases, aliquot-to-patient map, processed quantitative protein matrices, and BioSino RNA cohort join remain unverified.

public_file_inventory.warning: PDC file counts include raw, processed, identification, and metadata; not matched biological patients. The 8/9 Protein Assembly files have not yet been inspected for quantitative matrices.

datasets.name: TCGA-LIHC
datasets.publication_etiology: etiology labels require patient-level extraction and completeness audit
datasets.access: GDC public processed data; some clinical/genomics restricted; RPPA is targeted antibody measurement, NOT global mass-spectrometry proteome
datasets.next_action: Query harmonized manifest and clinical endpoints, tally unique cases and etiologies, avoid defining recurrence from OS/PFI without endpoint audit.

datasets.name: HCC paired tumor-adjacent microarray
datasets.access: GEO public processed series and GSE14520_Extra_Supplement.txt.gz; 488 are samples NOT patients
datasets.next_action: Parse supplementary table, confirm clinical time/event definition and train/test partitions at patient level.

observed_public_metadata.interpretation: Raw category counts only; patient linkage and event codebook not verified. HBV viral status 'CC'/'AVR-CC'/'N'/'.' not yet decoded.

datasets.name: HCC single-cell atlas
datasets.publication_etiology: HBV/HCV/nonviral described; group sizes must be audited
datasets.access: GEO processed 157.7MB count and metadata; raw restricted EGA EGAS00001004468
datasets.next_action: Download metadata first; map exact patient group and tissue origin; pseudobulk per patient, not per cell.

observed_public_metadata.interpretation: Public sample/patient label uniqueness; not evidence of cross-modality pairing.

datasets.name: HCC microvascular invasion single-cell
datasets.access: GEO series processed/raw tar; 3 MVI+ and 2 MVI- patients, 5 tumor + 5 adjacent
datasets.next_action: Use for MVI cell-type context; MVI is NOT observed recurrence; patient-level N=5.

datasets.next_action: Audit sample-to-patient and etiology, test for sample composition/processing confounding.
